pivHint: Proverbs tells us to GUARD our hearts, above all else. In basketball, the player who brings the ball up court is called the ______ guard.
winText: You found it. GUARD isn't just what you do to your heart — in basketball, the player who brings up the ball is called the POINT guard.
lossText: The word was POINT. GUARD was the pivot — in basketball, the player responsible for bringing up the ball is called the POINT guard. POINT is also what a speaker is trying to make when arguing an idea.
votdVerse: Above all else, guard your heart, for everything you do flows from it.
passageText: My son, pay attention to what I say; turn your ear to my words. Do not let them out of your sight, keep them within your heart; for they are life to those who find them and health to one’s whole body. Above all else, guard your heart, for everything you do flows from it.
